title.narrative: LEAP 4 Dev - Lift up the Ecosystem and Amplify Philanthropy for development: Elevating philanthropy as a key partner in localisation and collaboration for the achievement of the 2030 Agenda.

description.narrative: This action aims at leveraging philanthropy¿s engagement, funding, influence and added value to implement the 2030 Agenda and become a strategic partner in development co-operation, globally, but especially locally, in low- and middle-income countries. To reach this, it planned to (i) foster the enabling environment in which philanthropy operates; (ii) strengthen local and regional ecosystems that will accelerate impact and contribute to generating more domestic resources for civil society; and (iii) promote concrete alignment and investment within philanthropy and with other sectors (multi-stakeholder partnerships) to achieve the SDGs.
